liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Friend Of The Devil** (1 review): Reviewer highlights strong performances of Friend Of The Devil, Loser, Ship of Fools, and He's Gone [15]

## The recordings

- **gd1986-06-30.aud.Taggart-Holtz.116720.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 19 songs; 133 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd86-06-30.aud.eD.12935.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 135 min; rated 4.08/5 by 26 [2]. Said about its sound: The recording is described as having good sound quality; Phil's percussion features African and bongo-like touches, while keyboards sound reverbed and distant [15][20]
- **gd1986-06-30.164037.nak304.thomas.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 19 songs; 133 min [3]
- **gd1986-06-30.139282.set2.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 11 songs; 79 min [12]
- **gd1986-06-30.139270.set2.sbd.miller.flac24**: soundboard; 11 songs; 79 min [13]

## Around the show

- Attendee attended after mother encouraged them, recalling the happy vibe rather than specific music details [16]
- Fifteen-year-old attendee bought first tie-die and got stoned for the first time during the show [17]
- This was the last Grateful Dead performance in Cincinnati until 1989 and at this venue until 1997 [18]
- A river boat passed behind the stage during Ship of Fools on a hot, sprinkled day [23]
- Lights shined down center stage on Weir during Smokestack Lightning, creating a cool effect [24]
- Reviewer considers this their favorite show of the summer tour, noting the small venue's nice acoustics [21]
- Show felt more energetic and fun than others where Jerry seemed rushed or anxious to leave [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1986-06-30.aud.Taggart-Holtz.116720.flac16**: taped by Greg Holtz and Danny Taggart; transferred by Greg Holtz; source: Recording: Nakamichi CM100/CP-4 > Sony TC-D5M - OTS - Front of Lawn; [1]
- **gd86-06-30.aud.eD.12935.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD>MC>CDR [2]
- **gd1986-06-30.164037.nak304.thomas.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Stephen Thomas; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Stephen Thomas' Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 300 mics + CP4 shotguns > Sony D5M [3]. Also: Charlie Miller transferred tapes from Stephen Thomas masters, using Beyer M88 and Schoeps CMC4 MK41 sources [3]
- **gd1986-06-30.139282.set2.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Recording Info: SBD > Cassette Master (Tascam Deck/TDK SA-X90) [12]. Also: Joe B. Jones provided input on the pitch correction for this 24-to-16 bit transfer [12]
- **gd1986-06-30.139270.set2.sbd.miller.flac24**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Cassette Master (Tascam Deck/TDK SA-X90) [13]. Also: Joe B. Jones contributed to the pitch correction for this 24-bit set two recording [13]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Ron Delany Grateful Dead: [1986-06-30 River Bend Music Center, Cincinnati, OH, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1986-06-30-river-bend-music-center-cincinnati-oh-usa/) [27]
